messages:
Matthew: Heads-up — planning to roll SDK v11 tomorrow 2026-03-18 11:00 PT. High level: 1% canary -> 25% -> 100% across ~2h. Main blockers to call out: backcompat for older clients, small response envelope rename (meta -> metadata), and docs/client comms. Need volunteers for smoke, compat gate, docs, and rollback runbook.

Caroline: I can own smoke + canary monitoring. Will run the checklist and share results in #eng-platform/smoke. Planning to validate key flows within 30m of 1% cutover. :white_check_mark:

Jenna: I got client comms and release notes. Drafting a short migration note for partners, will ping legal if any wording needs sign-off. ETA for draft: tonight EOD PT.

Akshay: I'll own the compatibility gating automation. I'll run the regression suite against the v11 binary and the old client matrix (node/python/java). If anything fails, we abort and tag rollback. I'll also run quick perf p95 checks.

Matthew: TL;DR of smoke steps I want validated: token auth, streaming, embeddings, and the small metadata rename. Caroline, can you confirm streaming unchanged?

Caroline: Streaming appears unchanged in canary build I tested locally, but I'll exercise it under load. Quick smoke command for others:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .
```
I'll run that against canary endpoint and the routing layer.

Jenna: For client comms, I'm including a snippet showing the metadata rename and a short migration diff. Example blurb: "Note: the response envelope field `meta` is renamed to `metadata` in SDK v11. This is a rename only; contents unchanged. See migration example in the repo."

Akshay: For gating logic: if any of the regression tests fail or error rate > 0.5% on canary, we'll stop and rollback. I'll publish the automated gate to the rollout dashboard and tag failed tests.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: env=prod, version=sdk-v11, canary=1%, start=2026-03-18T18:00:00Z (11:00 PT). Notifying oncall.

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby during the window and will take pager for 11:00-13:30 PT. If you need a forced rollback, ping me and include the rollback tag.

Matthew: Rollback plan (short): create a rollback tag `sdk-v11-rollback`, reroute traffic to `sdk-v10-*` variant, and run smoke. Caroline/Akshay to verify service health before full cutover. Jenna to send a short client-facing note if rollback occurs.

Caroline: I'll post smoke results here. If 1% looks clean at +30m, we proceed to 25% at 11:45 PT, then to 100% by ~13:00 PT.

Jenna: Will post the comms draft in #eng-platform/docs and link to CHANGELOG PR.

Akshay: I'll keep an eye on the canary dashboard and post gate status updates (pass/fail) with the automated logs.

Matthew: Perfect. Quick ask: whoever is running the final 100% step, please wait for both Caroline and Akshay thumbs up. No auto-100% without manual OK.

Caroline: agreed :thumbsup:

Jenna: noted, will coordinate client pings post-100% rollout.

Matthew: Thanks all. If anything pops up overnight, drop it here and we'll triage async.
